LanguageData.RA_SearchHint: Search research, mods, what it unlocks or makes possible…
LanguageData.RA_NextMatchTip: Next match (Enter in the search box)
LanguageData.RA_Empty: No research here with these filters.
LanguageData.RA_Help: Click: select – details on the right · Shift+click: queue with everything it needs · Ctrl+click: queue only this · Double click: research now (or queue) · Ctrl+hover: show the whole way there and everything that follows · Right click: menu · Click an icon on a card: its info · Wheel: zoom · Drag: move · Home: back to what is researched now
LanguageData.RA_FocusOn: Focus: show only its way there and what follows
LanguageData.RA_TipClick: Click: details · Shift: queue the way · Ctrl+click: only this · Double click: research now · Ctrl+hover: whole way · Right click: more
LanguageData.RA_QueueEmpty: The queue is empty – click a research project to add it with everything it needs.
LanguageData.RA_AdvNoBench: No research bench yet – build one first.
LanguageData.RA_AdvNoResearchers: Nobody does research – turn on Research in the work tab.
LanguageData.RA_AdvPick: Nothing is being researched – click a project to start.
LanguageData.RA_AdvBlocked: Nothing in the queue can start now – see the red items (bench, techprints, study).
LanguageData.RA_AdvRate: {0} researchers · about {1} points an hour of research work
LanguageData.RA_SetReplace: Use Research Atlas as the research window
LanguageData.RA_SetReplaceTip: Off: the game's own research window (or another research mod) is used. The "Vanilla view" button in the window switches for a moment.
LanguageData.RA_SetAutoStart: Start the next research from the queue by itself
LanguageData.RA_SetAutoStartTip: When a research is finished, the first one in the queue that can start begins.
LanguageData.RA_SetCompact: Filters hide research (off: they only dim it)
LanguageData.RA_SetCompactTip: With filters on, the tree is arranged again only from what is left – much shorter with big mod packs.
LanguageData.RA_SetMinimap: Show the side panel (researchers, minimap, random picks)
LanguageData.RA_CacheCleared: The research trees will be arranged again the next time they open.
LanguageData.RA_FixesOff: The separate Research Fixer mod is active, so these fixes are off here. Turn Research Fixer off – Research Atlas does the same, and takes over its settings.
LanguageData.RA_SetMinimapTip: A panel on the right with who researches and how fast, the minimap of the whole tree (with search hits) and, in random mode, the projects to pick from.
LanguageData.RA_GroupByModTip: Projects of one mod stay together in every column (the tree gets a little more lines).
LanguageData.RA_ResearchSpeedTip: Research speed (not researching at the moment)
LanguageData.RA_RandomNone: Nothing can be researched right now.
LanguageData.RA_RandomNoRerolls: No new choice left – one comes back with every finished research.
LanguageData.RA_MinimapTip: The whole tree. Click or drag to move there. Gold dots: search hits.
LanguageData.RA_SetRandom: Random mode: pick from three offered projects
LanguageData.RA_SetRandomTip: Like Semi Random Research: the side panel offers three random projects you can research now. Pick one; new ones come when it is finished. You can still pick anything in the tree.
LanguageData.RA_State_Locked: Locked – something before it is missing
LanguageData.RA_DeepSearchTip: Search also in the descriptions of unlocked things and in what the unlocked workbenches can make without more research (meals at the electric stove, things at a new bench…).
